about: The simulated Claude memory that setup reads in this prototype: what Mike Turner's memory would hold about his business. It comes from no real account.

items.title: Business
items.text: Mike Turner owns Turner Plumbing in Oakland, California, and answers its phone himself between jobs.

items.title: Trade
items.text: Turner Plumbing does home plumbing: drain clearing, leak repair and water heater flushes.

items.title: Service area
items.text: Turner Plumbing works in Oakland, Berkeley, Alameda and Emeryville.

items.title: Hours
items.text: Open Monday to Friday, 8 am to 6 pm, and Saturday, 9 am to 1 pm. Closed on Sundays.
